subject: Re: Redwood Intro — Post-call recap & EoQ priority check

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood Intro — Post-call recap & EoQ priority check

Hi Rebecca — thanks again for taking the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side:

- Key discovery notes:
  - Primary use case: real-time reranking of customer support suggestions across 3 regions (US/EU/APAC)
  - Expected Q3 pilot, production in Q4 if procurement and security checks go smoothly
  - Main constraints: PII controls, VPC-only deployment preferred for production, and predictable latency

- What Redwood can deliver (high level):
  - Hosted + Dedicated options for staging → predictable throughput for production
  - KV caching + intelligent batching to reduce per-token cost for high QPS endpoints
  - SOC2 evidence and audit logs; we can run through a short security checklist for procurement

Proposed next steps:
1) I attached a short proposal with an estimated configuration and ballpark pricing (redwood-proposal-apexanalytics.pdf).
2) If that looks reasonable, can we schedule a 30-minute procurement / security sync next week to align on SOW and timelines?
3) I'd love to understand whether budget/approval is still on track for an end-of-quarter (EoQ) decision or if priorities have shifted.

Links: demo recording (internal): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c4d-demo-recording

Attachment: [redwood-proposal-apexanalytics.pdf (PDF, 85KB)]

Thanks — I can update the proposal to match any procurement requirements you share.

Best,
Aditya Rao

Aditya — appreciate the recap and the proposal. Quick answers:

- This aligns with what we discussed. I'll need to run the proposal by procurement and my VP (they're out this week but back Monday).
- Procurement will need a short SOW + estimated monthly costs for the Dedicated pool (they're sensitive to sustained commit numbers).
- Security is the bigger gating item — can your team share the SOC2 attestation and a short answers doc to our security questionnaire?

I'll aim to have initial feedback by early next week. If you can send the SOW + point estimate for a 3-month pilot, that would help accelerate.

Thanks,

Hey Rebecca — just circling back as we get into the end of the quarter. Wanted to check whether procurement/security had a chance to review the proposal and SOW? A couple quick items that would help us:

- Is the 3-month pilot still on the table for your team timeline-wise?
- Any change to budget/approval timing — still targeting an EoQ decision or has priority shifted into Q3/Q4?

If it's helpful I can share a brief procurement-friendly cost sheet (line items: reserved GPUs, data transfer, support) and a copy of the SOC2 report under an NDA. No rush — just trying to understand timing so we can recommend the right plan (and avoid over-committing capacity).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call this week if that's easiest.

Best,
Aditya

Hi Rebecca — final EoQ check on this thread. We're seeing a few customers lock in pilots this week to secure end-of-quarter capacity and the associated pricing; wanted to make sure ApexAnalytics isn't being deprioritized inadvertently. Quick options:

- If procurement needs numbers, I can send a one-page cost summary/statement of work by EOD tomorrow.
- If timeline slipped, happy to propose a deferred start with an estimated hold commitment to preserve pricing.

Would you still expect a decision before the end of the quarter? If not, no problem — just let me know the updated target and I'll align our capacity and discount recommendations.

If easier, here's a link to book 30 minutes: https://calendly.com/aditya-redwood/30min

Thanks for the update — appreciate it.
